caption.en: Figure 38.1 — The same format repair preserves both the correct amount and the wrong one.
caption.zh-hans: 图 38.1：同一种格式修正既保留了正确金额，也保留了错误金额。

alt.en: Current and historical prompts both produce 750 followed by a period. The normalizer removes the period without changing digits. Current amount 750 now passes strict matching; historical amount 750 still fails the required 600. No model parameter changes.
alt.zh-hans: 现行和历史限额问题都输出了带句号的 750。格式修正规则删除句号而保留数字。现行限额 750 通过严格匹配，历史限额仍错，因为要求的是 600。模型参数没有改变。

text.en: Strict pass; meaning was already correct
text.zh-hans: 严格匹配通过；原意已正确

flow.en: Three repeats on current + three on stale premise = six new strict passes.
flow.zh-hans: 现行限额 3 次 + 纠正旧前提 3 次 = 新增 6 次严格匹配通过。

text.zh-hans: 仍然答错；语义验收未改善

flow.en: Three further displays change; their factual claims do not. Both checkpoints remain rejected.
flow.zh-hans: 另有 3 次显示改变，事实主张却没变。两个检查点仍不通过验收。
